events.</p></div></a></div></section><div class="flex w-full flex-col items-center"><div class="box-border flex w-full flex-col items-center gap-12 px-6 py-16 md:py-20"><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col items-center gap-12"><div class="flex w-full flex-col items-center gap-3 text-center max-w-[680px]"><h2 class="font-serif w-full text-[28px] font-[600] leading-[120%] text-[var(--text-primary)] md:text-[40px]">Frequently asked questions</h2></div><div class="flex w-full flex-col items-center"><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">What is an MCP connector?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">An MCP connector makes tools from an app or server available to Manus. Connect an app from the catalog or add a server you trust, then ask Manus to use its MCP tools in a task.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Which apps can I connect to Manus?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">The Connectors catalog includes apps such as Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Outlook, Google Calendar and Shopify. You can also attach selected Google Drive files. Available apps and Google Workspace services can depend on your account.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">How do I add a custom MCP server to Manus?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Open Connectors, choose Create, then Add MCP by URL. Enter a name and server URL. For a command-based server or an existing JSON configuration, choose Custom MCP or Import MCP by JSON instead.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I connect Gmail, Slack or Notion to Manus?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes. After connecting your account, Manus can search Gmail messages, start work from a Slack channel message, or find answers in your Notion workspace. The actions available depend on the app and the account you connect.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">What is the difference between connectors and Agent Skills?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Connectors give Manus access to apps and their tools. Agent Skills are reusable abilities for tasks. You can use both: connect a source first, then use a skill to work with it. Learn more about <a href="/features/agent-skills" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-[var(--text-blue)] underline hover:text-[var(--text-brand)] clickable cursor-pointer">Agent Skills</a>.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Where can I find an MCP server list in Manus?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Open Connectors to browse the apps available to your account. If you already have a trusted remote MCP server, choose Add MCP by URL to connect it by its server URL.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I use a Figma MCP server with Manus?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Manus can import a selected Figma frame into a task. For a separate Figma MCP server that you trust, Custom MCP lets you enter a compatible URL or command; the tools available depend on that server.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">How do I create a custom API connector for an external API in Manus?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Open Connectors, choose Create, then Custom API. Give it a name, add a secret name and value for the key or token, and optionally add a note about how Manus should use the API.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">How do I connect Google Sheets MCP to Manus?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Open the Google Workspace connector and look for Sheets in the available services. If it appears for your account, choose an access level and authenticate with Google.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I use connectors in a Manus Project?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes. A Project can recommend connectors for you to connect and enable. You can also publish a custom MCP connector to Projects.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><section class="px-5 pb-24 pt-16 md:px-6 md:pb-32 md:pt-20"><div class="mx-auto flex max-w-[760px]
